gate: Exact drafts >= 60% of the denominator overall; every ambiguous row flagged or rejected; zero ready-but-wrong (incl. spurious ready rows); quality check rejects >= 90% of poor held-out sources and accepts every clean one; per-format below 60% must be labelled limited.
gateDenominator: Every readable (non-ambiguous) row of every held-out page of every format, grayscale and photo-of-screen included. Omitted rows count as failures. Rows are never removed after the run.
unsupportedLayouts: Fixed-suit notation (a hand that names Cracks, Bams or Dots instead of printing a colour)
Pages where the pattern is split over several printed lines
Row text rotated more than about 15 degrees after page correction
